name: Primary dystonia, DYT17 type

criteria.description: Onset of dystonia symptoms before age 30
Progressive generalized dystonia involving multiple body regions
Identification of pathogenic variants in the DYT17 gene (CIZ1)
Exclusion of secondary causes of dystonia such as drug-induced or structural brain lesions
Positive family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of early-onset progressive generalized dystonia with genetic confirmation of DYT17 mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of secondary dystonias and confirmation by molecular genetic testing.

laboratory: Exclusion of metabolic causes of dystonia
imaging: Brain MRI typically normal or nonspecific
other: Absence of secondary causes on clinical and laboratory evaluation

distinguishingFeatures: Onset in childhood with diurnal fluctuation
Presence of parkinsonism or other movement disorders

redFlags: Rapid progression of dystonia with systemic symptoms
Onset after age 40 suggesting secondary causes
Presence of cognitive decline or seizures indicating alternative diagnosis
